info.name: JobLoom — Missing CSP Header Evidence (Automated)
info.description:
Automated, read-only reproduction of postman/guides/Vulnerability/CSP-HEADER-NOT-SET-EVIDENCE-GUIDE.md.

## Run
1. Keep the existing frontend running at http://localhost:5173.
2. Import this file into Postman Desktop (or use a Desktop Agent that can reach localhost).
3. Choose Run collection, select all three requests in their saved order, use one iteration, and Run. No environment, login, tokens, test data, or pasted scripts are required.
4. View the final request's Test Results. For a report, open its response Visualize tab when available. The collection variable csp_evidence_json contains the full timestamped evidence; csp_verdict contains the conclusion. Individual Send requests do not share run-local comparison state; use the Collection Runner for the complete proof.

The collection automatically sends GET /, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml; checks HTTP 200, HTML content type, JobLoom identity, absence of enforcing and report-only CSP headers, and absence of HTML CSP meta tags using an HTML parser. It compares each fallback body with the current run's root. Redirect following and the cookie jar are disabled for these requests. State resets at request 01 each iteration; failed requests cannot reuse a previous root.

IMPORTANT: passing assertions mean the missing-header finding was reproduced, not that the application is secure. Meta policy, report-only policy, and identical fallback content are separate baseline checks. If CSP is present, an error page is returned, or the responses differ, the relevant assertions fail; inspect the evidence. An empty CSP header counts as present. Missing CSP alone does not establish XSS. This collection does not modify application data or configuration.

## Evidence and screenshots
Capture the Runner's results for all requests plus each response's URL, status, and complete Headers list. The final Visualize report summarizes the three URLs and displays the captured evidence. Postman scripts collect evidence automatically; capturing GUI screenshots remains a manual step. Enable response retention in the Runner if needed. Copy csp_evidence_json or export run results before closing the run; collection-variable persistence depends on Runner settings.

## Optional command line (Newman installed)
From JobLoom-BE-SSD-main:
newman run postman/collections/CSP-Header-Not-Set.postman_collection.json --timeout-request 15000 --reporters cli,json --reporter-json-export /tmp/jobloom-csp-run.json

The JSON report contains responses and assertion results. A successful exit means the documented vulnerability evidence was reproduced. The frontend must already be running; the collection cannot start a local server. To test another authorized frontend, change the collection variable csp_frontend_url (omit the trailing slash).

## Script reference
Uses Postman's built-in cheerio parser: https://learning.postman.com/docs/tests-and-scripts/write-scripts/postman-sandbox-reference/pm-require/
